start.text: (A man with a torch and a bunch of keys, by the generator.) Who's that? — Oh. Top room. You're alive. I'm Suresh. The landlord. Her husband.

aunty.text: She went to the temple on Tuesday. (He looks at her door, at the slippers.) That's all.

light.text: UV. The BBMP put them up at the camps. They don't come into the purple. Don't ask me why — I don't care why.

rules.text: Rules. No noise after five. No lights facing the road. The generator runs the lamp, the lamp keeps us. Here — water, rice. And the lamp needs petrol. Whatever you find, it comes to the shelf.

manju.text: Manju is on the terrace with his table. He takes things now, not money. Your phone is a brick. (He goes back to the generator.)

again.text: Petrol, food, water. To the shelf. And quiet after five.

day1.text: (Grey morning. His torch is off.) Day one. The rules hold. — Deepa from room one hasn't come home. The lab girl. Three nights now.

day1_store.text: Mani keeps a store behind his stall. Take what's there, he won't mind. Steel, stones. You know what to make of them.

day1_bye.text: And the shelf. Always the shelf.

day1_again.text: Mani's store. The shelf. Quiet after five.

turned.text: (He hasn't slept. The torch is dead in his hand.) The lamp went at two. They came up the steps. Mani — (he stops). Without the lamp the hill is theirs.

turned_go.text: There's a man in Indiranagar. Uncle, at the tiffin room — a generator, a shutter that comes down. We go at first light.

moving.text: First light. Take what you can carry. Eight things, not one more.

cafe.text: (By the shutter, his keys in his lap.) Uncle's generator. Three nights, he says. Then we'll see.

cafe_dark.text: Cubbon. The army's lamps. If they're still on.

camp.text: Hold. That's all I know how to do.

palace.text: A palace. (He almost laughs.) My father sold peanuts at that gate.

lalbagh.text: Orchids. (He shakes his head.) My wife would have known all their names.
